prefix.description: The start of the key, to recognize it: lf_ and 8 characters.

lastUsedAt.description: To within five minutes; none until it's used.

expiresAt.description: None for a key that doesn't expire.

notify.description: Whether the user's phones are told when this key adds a match, or cancels, postpones, moves or removes one that hasn't kicked off (NOTE-1).

key.description: The key itself, shown only this once: send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

description: A new key, with the key itself. The server keeps only a hash, so it can't show it again.
